basic_details.short_information: Indian Maritime University (IMU), Chennai, has one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in a sponsored project funded by the Ministry of Port, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Government of India, paying Rs. 37,000 + HRA in Years 1–2 and Rs. 42,000 + HRA in Year 3. The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Ocean Engineering, Mechanical, Aerospace, Applied Mechanics, Computational Engineering, or allied fields. Applications go through a Google form and the last date is 6 December 2026.

rows.details: Indian Maritime University (A Central University under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, GOI)
Design and Safety Evaluation of Carbon Fiber Composite Hull for Deep Sea Submersibles and Ocean Structures
Ministry of Port, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Government of India
3 years; initially posted for 6 months, extendable

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the University
content_sections.text: Indian Maritime University is a Central University under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, established by an Act of Parliament in 2008. Its headquarters are at East Coast Road, Uthandi, Sholinganallur (P.O), Chennai–600119.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian nationals may apply. B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Ocean Engineering, Mechanical, Aerospace, Applied Mechanics, Computational Engineering, or allied fields with a strong academic record. Strong fundamentals in Finite Element Methods (FEM). Hands-on experience writing sub-routines in ABAQUS. Hands-on experience on CFRP composite laminate modeling, fracture models, nonlinear buckling and collapse simulations in ABAQUS. The age limit is not more than 35 years. The notice gives relaxation to OBC/SC/ST/PWD/Women category as per GOI norms, and age relaxation for highly deserving candidates. The date for counting age is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Hostel accommodation may be provided on a chargeable basis; in such cases, HRA will not be admissible. The project runs for 3 years. The JRF is initially posted for 6 months, and the posting is extendable depending on satisfactory performance of the candidate and availability of funds. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure. The selected candidate will be given an opportunity to register for the Ph.D. program at IMU in accordance with university norms, when IMU officially releases the Ph.D. admission notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The application for the JRF post is to be filled in the Google form at https://forms.gle/tDa97YcqXaV8USGv5 . The last date is 6 December 2026, and the notice says the date is extendable if desired applications are not received. The notice does not name any documents to attach. For queries, contact the Principal Investigator on +91-9989403950 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview as per IMU norms. Selected candidates will be intimated by e-mail for an offline/online interview. No TA/DA shall be paid for the offline interview. The decision of the selection committee will be final. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has IMU announced?
faq.answer: IMU has announced one Junior Research Fellow post for the sponsored project on carbon fiber composite hulls for deep sea submersibles and ocean structures.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 6 December 2026. The notice says the date is extendable if desired applications are not received.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Ocean Engineering, Mechanical, Aerospace, Applied Mechanics, Computational Engineering, or allied fields with a strong academic record.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 years, with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/PWD/Women category as per GOI norms, and age relaxation for highly deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IMU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- + HRA in Years 1–2 and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA in Year 3.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the IMU JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the pay is stated as plus HRA. If hostel accommodation is provided on a chargeable basis, HRA will not be admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application in the Google form at https://forms.gle/tDa97YcqXaV8USGv5 before 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will IMU select the Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and selected candidates will be intimated by e-mail for an offline/online interview. The selection committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IMU JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure of 3 years, and it is liable for termination with a 30-day notice period if performance is not deemed satisfactory.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the IMU JRF interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA shall be paid for the offline interview.
